dialogue_font_8x16: ASCII 0x20-0x7E, 16 bytes per glyph (1bpp rows). Source: X11 koi8x16 bitmap font (build/fonts/koi8x16.pcf). In-game: ROM 0x182000 ($30:A000), 16x16 slot layout, left half used.
keyboards: Pre-rendered 16x16 keyboard cells (name entry, postcard UPPER/lower/symbols), 2bpp staging layout, bank $38.

map_label_font_8x8.note: 2bpp SNES tiles, colour 3 = letter, 1 = outline, 0 = transparent. Derived from X11 koi5x8. Slot -> character:

menu_labels: Bank 7 label art (ROM 0x38000-0x3B2FF), 2bpp. Each 16px label row is stored as a run of top-half tiles followed by bottom-half tiles.
